summaries.it-swe-ai: Software Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in AI-powered software development, scalable microservices, event-driven architecture, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Built a Model Context Protocol server and multi-agent LLM automation for enterprise compliance workflows at Turbot HQ, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90% while meeting CIS, NIST, and SOC 2 regulatory standards.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed a multi-agent AI architecture on the OpenAI Agents SDK, translating a business security requirement (preventing public-cloud misconfigurations) into an automated technical solution: LLM agents that generate policy commands, validate them in a live test environment, self-correct failures, and score accounts against an internal security metric.

Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, embedding AI capabilities directly into a production enterprise platform to give LLM agents standardized, real-time access to cloud and security data.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a scalable microservices architecture powering Turbot Guardrails, a security-compliance SaaS platform; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Built a Kafka-based, event-driven pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was successfully enforced against a resource; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for reliability.

Built a RAG-based Pydantic AI agent deployed as a serverless AWS Lambda function to resolve cross-team business queries, ingesting internal documentation into S3 vector storage and surfacing it through Slack.

Authored multi-cloud compliance modules covering 1,000+ resource checks across CIS, NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS v4, SOC 2, and FedRAMP regulatory frameworks for enterprise customers in finance, healthcare, and government — cutting audit time 50%.
Mentored teammates on adopting AI-assisted engineering tools (Claude Code, Cursor) into their daily workflows.
